        <section class="content article-content mb-6" itemprop="articleBody">
          <p>Follow this article to receive email notifications when content is added to Optimizely Opal for 2025.</p><h2 id="h_01KE7JW8951PG05TPWK3C8NQHW">December 23</h2><h4 id="h_01KBG4R1PC6CDHWVWGP9EQDYX9">OCP connector tools</h4><ul><li data-list-item-id="ed85b1f11e2a5c83a122aa43438895ceb">Released the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/42170700624269" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Figma connector tools</a> in Opal, which let you access Figma's design data, facilitate collaboration workflows, and automate the handoff process between designers and developers.</li></ul><h2 id="h_01KESQ19CNSNKC2QKRY0X3YF3S">December 18</h2><h4 id="h_01KCSKNRV6KAZFEPB7XA9J7BTD">Agents</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee0312a2854aad7fb62bec841194f8880">
<p>Released an update for the <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/41095776750221" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Technical SEO Auditor agent</a>, including the addition of two new tools, <code>create_canvas</code> and <code>convert_to_pdf</code>. The update includes the following improvements:</p>
<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="edb070c2a47d349514eb0825428ad11dd">Clear report metadata (generation date, devices assessed, and page URL).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea24d8b8bee79cad2b244ab77c740eac6">Straightforward executive summary section.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee1ae2cef912d1f95d3d90588689610dc">Improved structure and professional appearance.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efa55aa599745d5715c8c3a26bbc4034f">Clean PDF export capability.</li>
</ul>
<p>See <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39133106856205#h_01KBNMFESW9XV68SV3VWXSKZM6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Update an agent in the agent directory</a> for instructions.</p>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eee07d7cef5e19318e93c4a6afd1ca602">Released the Experiment Review agent for Feature Experimentation, which lets you <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/38937573368589#h_01K31EBVMRSFGDVKSK23W2R5G3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Run a pre-launch experiment review with Opal</a>. The agent reviews your Feature Experimentation experiment configuration and recommends changes to maximize your odds of reaching statistical significance.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KCSM42YQM2S3GR35BT4GHPTJ">Tools</h4><ul><li data-list-item-id="e4c3dfa7487ed22521677e3eab8fcf836">Added an <code>opal_tool</code> flag in the <code>functions</code> section while <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39195307678221#h_01K4DKR8H7Y20VAB7DEVP7DEN6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">configuring and defining your custom tool</a> that includes an extra section in app settings form that lets users register your app in Opal easier.</li></ul><h2 id="h_01KCSKTRZ32C4B58FTH4Q641JT">December 17</h2><h4 id="h_01KCQ1D0SF18XPSPZC0EYEG7DH">Opal Chat</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e719aa7da5fbd958dc8427f6530e5d900"><div>Added a scroll bar and max height to the <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opal Chat</a> input box, making it easier to enter prompts and agent calls.</div></li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2decc156075b0bcbeeaed1fa4f64bf98"><div>Added thumbnails of images when you upload them in <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opal Chat</a>, letting you easily see which images are being uploaded to Opal.</div></li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KCQ22Z2S8R7ECNGTKB29CRP7">Tools</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2e8c6e967f9c49898aa9cfe867345017">Added a requirement that <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/39189641171981" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">custom tool's</a> names and tool registry names be unique across an Opal instance. Some customers may have multiple Opal instances in same organization, so now the registry and tool names need to be unique for that one instance. This lets you have duplicate names for the tools or registries across different Opal instances in the same organization.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0b3fab4e26283d65fffe2f23467cfde6">Released system tools for <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/42021008282765" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Campaign</a> and <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/41787261663117" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Configured Commerce</a>, making it easier to view your campaigns in <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/4413200424717" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Optimizely Campaign</a> and help you interact with the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/4413199676941-Navigate-the-Configured-Commerce-admin-console" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Configured Commerce Admin Console</a>, such as analyzing your site's error logs or retrieving information about a product or customer order.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5911ab25cc23107c600f37ce5469fd7e">Updated the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39340107628429-System-tools-overview#email" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><code>send_email</code> tool </a>to display an interaction island for you to confirm sending the email from Opal Chat. This ensures Opal does not perform actions  automatically without your approval.</li>
</ul><h4 id="h_01KCPZJNKQ59TT31MGAVDTE8MJ">Agents</h4><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8da5d26c58643010412b6ad9a21e7a91"><div>Added breadcrumbs to agents and instructions to easily return to the previous page.</div></li>

2025 Optimizely Opal release notes – Support Help Center                   

[Skip to main content](#page-container)

Follow this article to receive email notifications when content is added to Optimizely Opal for 2025.

## December 23

#### OCP connector tools

*   Released the [Figma connector tools](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/42170700624269) in Opal, which let you access Figma's design data, facilitate collaboration workflows, and automate the handoff process between designers and developers.

## December 18

#### Agents

*   Released an update for the [Technical SEO Auditor agent](/hc/en-us/articles/41095776750221), including the addition of two new tools, `create_canvas` and `convert_to_pdf`. The update includes the following improvements:
    
    *   Clear report metadata (generation date, devices assessed, and page URL).
    *   Straightforward executive summary section.
    *   Improved structure and professional appearance.
    *   Clean PDF export capability.
    
    See [Update an agent in the agent directory](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39133106856205#h_01KBNMFESW9XV68SV3VWXSKZM6) for instructions.
    
*   Released the Experiment Review agent for Feature Experimentation, which lets you [Run a pre-launch experiment review with Opal](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/38937573368589#h_01K31EBVMRSFGDVKSK23W2R5G3). The agent reviews your Feature Experimentation experiment configuration and recommends changes to maximize your odds of reaching statistical significance.

#### Tools

*   Added an `opal_tool` flag in the `functions` section while [configuring and defining your custom tool](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39195307678221#h_01K4DKR8H7Y20VAB7DEVP7DEN6) that includes an extra section in app settings form that lets users register your app in Opal easier.

## December 17

#### Opal Chat

*   Added a scroll bar and max height to the [Opal Chat](/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813) input box, making it easier to enter prompts and agent calls.
    
*   Added thumbnails of images when you upload them in [Opal Chat](/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813), letting you easily see which images are being uploaded to Opal.
    

#### Tools

*   Added a requirement that [custom tool's](/hc/en-us/articles/39189641171981) names and tool registry names be unique across an Opal instance. Some customers may have multiple Opal instances in same organization, so now the registry and tool names need to be unique for that one instance. This lets you have duplicate names for the tools or registries across different Opal instances in the same organization.
*   Released system tools for [Campaign](/hc/en-us/articles/42021008282765) and [Configured Commerce](/hc/en-us/articles/41787261663117), making it easier to view your campaigns in [Optimizely Campaign](/hc/en-us/articles/4413200424717) and help you interact with the [Configured Commerce Admin Console](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/4413199676941-Navigate-the-Configured-Commerce-admin-console), such as analyzing your site's error logs or retrieving information about a product or customer order.
*   Updated the [`send_email` tool](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39340107628429-System-tools-overview#email) to display an interaction island for you to confirm sending the email from Opal Chat. This ensures Opal does not perform actions  automatically without your approval.

#### Agents

*   Added breadcrumbs to agents and instructions to easily return to the previous page.
    
*   Added a toggle to enable or disable specialized agents in Opal Chat, letting you restrict agent usage. See step six in [Initial configuration section in the Create specialized agents documentation](/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413#h_01K4B8V75FGQNX6RN50GXTCWMM).
    
*   Improved the ability to reliably call agents through @ mention in [Opal Chat](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813-Optimizely-Opal-Chat#h_01JZ3ZSXCJH7TJ006QZKKVYD0T).
    
*   Added icons in the **Agent Directory** to indicate if an [agent is activated in your Opal instance](/hc/en-us/articles/39295797340045#h_01KBNJREFRWJDSWKPNECG64S9F) or if a [new version is available](/hc/en-us/articles/39295797340045#h_01KBNJFZ4XBWA5PKFFXPW83AHQ), making it easy to quickly identify agent information.
    
*   Removed the force override toggle in the **Agent Directory** in favor of the option to update the agent, streamlining the update process. See [Update an agent in the agent directory](/hc/en-us/articles/39133106856205#h_01KBNMFESW9XV68SV3VWXSKZM6).
    
*   Added the ability to delete a variable in the [variable page](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413-Create-specialized-agents#h_01K4B9C7ZBERJTHZ1AV7J40NM9), letting you easily delete unneeded variables. 
    
*   Added the ability to [delete an agent from the **Agent** page](/hc/en-us/articles/39133106856205#h_01KC9Z6DSRZ5GGN0VTM6ZA2EGN) using the **More options (...)** menu. This makes it even easier to delete agents and removes additional steps.  
    

## December 11

Optimizely released the following [system tools for Optimizely Data Platform (ODP)](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/42165689708813-System-tools-for-Optimizely-Data-Platform-ODP):

*   `suggest_odp_audiences` – Suggests new real-time audiences you can create in ODP based on your existing schema.
*   `odp_get_audience_list` – Returns the list of existing real-time audience IDs within the connected ODP instance. 
*   `odp_get_audience_by_id` – Retrieves the full configuration and metadata for a specific real-time audience. 
*   `create_odp_audiences` – Creates a real-time audience based on a natural-language description. 

## December 9

Optimizely released the following [system tools for Content Recommendations](/hc/en-us/articles/41743767534477):

*   `contentrecs_top_content` – Retrieves the top-performing content items, ranked by user interactions, from Optimizely Content Recommendations.
*   `contentrecs_top_topics` – Retrieves performance metrics for the most engaging topics, based on user interactions, from Optimizely Content Recommendations.
*   `contentrecs_top_recommendation_widgets` – Analyzes recommendation widget performance in Optimizely Content Recommendations. 

## December 4

#### Opal Chat

*   Released [canvas](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/41120389883277), a dynamic and collaborative environment for building, customizing, and delivering interactive digital assets, applications, and complex content with Opal. This workspace lets you create and manage digital assets in real-time. 
*   Added a **View Agents** button in new chat threads which displays the last three modified agents in your Opal instance, letting you easily call new agents. See [Access Opal Chat](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813#h_01JZ8S4MXHZVWX91KHPFTGYQEW).

#### Agents

*   Updated the **Agent Directory** to include tags so you can see which agents you have already installed and also which agents have version updates. See [Agent directory](/hc/en-us/articles/39295797340045).
*   Added the ability to add up to five example preferred outputs to specialized agents, which helps Opal evaluate its responses. See the [Add preferred output section in the Create specialized agent documentation](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413#h_01KACEGNBW103Q3S521AN6YA5R). 
    *   The quality score of an agent run, based on these examples, is viewable in [the specialized agent logs](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39133106856205#h_01KAH2GPFXDGBCFJ2EEWBJB9EN).
*   Enhanced the text editor for the **Prompt Template** when creating specialized agents improving the Markdown writing experience. See the [Configure the prompt template section in the Create specialized agents documentation](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39333562134413#h_01K4B8XE1EZYDZ3Y2Y8RWZW27D).
*   Released the [Content Adaption agent](/hc/en-us/articles/41095349197069) to the [Agent directory](/hc/en-us/articles/39295797340045) which helps you repurpose core content by reformatting, rephrasing, and optimizing it for specific platforms such as social media, email, or web pages. 
*   Released the [UTM Creation agent](/hc/en-us/articles/41095468934797) to the [Agent directory](/hc/en-us/articles/39295797340045) which simplifies the creation of UTM parameters (tags added to the end of a URL to help track the source, medium, and name of a marketing campaign in website analytics).
*   Released the [LinkedIn InMail Copy Generation agent](/hc/en-us/articles/41095715603341) to the [Agent directory](/hc/en-us/articles/39295797340045) which crafts engaging headlines, body text, and calls-to-action that align with LinkedIn's professional audience and ad specifications, optimizing for B2B outreach.
